## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION: Weak breadth and concentrated leadership. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Technology driving gains while Financials, Energy and Utilities lag, supporting a cautious stance given mixed internals.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Technology leads: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +23.77% | 1M: +71.50%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples and Materials show pockets of strength with MNST (1W: +11.89% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND and select miners; Tech outperformance is concentrated.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -6.75%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -4.59%) BELOW TREND. Financials and Utilities underperformed on the week with JPM (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND and sector-wide softness evident.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +23.77% | 1M: +71.50%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +14.80% | 1M: +24.49%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +13.64%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: SHOP (1W: -13.52% | 1M: -1.75%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -10.05% | 1M: -1.33%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.83% | 1M: -30.63%) BELOW TREND, OXY (1W: -9.67% | 1M: -9.40%) BELOW TREND, MO (1W: -8.63% | 1M: +0.98%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in select high-multiple and energy names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +23.77% | 1M: +71.50%) ABOVE TREND; watch for short-term profit-taking given narrow sector concentration.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech mixed but leadership-heavy: AAPL (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +12.60%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +11.27%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +17.01%) ABOVE TREND; Tech sector return +6.30% (24 stocks) and is the primary source of gains, though concentration risk is high. Sector breadth: 4/11 sectors positive.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials soft: JPM (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +3.41%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: +0.00% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND; weakness across the group leaves Financials a headwind for broader risk-taking.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare under pressure with notable exceptions: UNH (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +23.81%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -2.58% | 1M: -8.28%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -1.54% | 1M: -0.71%) BELOW TREND; sector negative on the week with defensive names not uniformly leading.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selectively positioned exposure to Technology leaders showing clear momentum while acknowledging concentrated leadership risk. Reduce exposure to lagging Financials and Energy names until breadth improves. Monitor correction candidates for tactical entries rather than broad reallocation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +23.77% | 1M: +71.50%) ABOVE TREND — look for follow-through. BEARISH: XOM (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -6.75%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND — continued weakness would keep sector drag.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Technology (outperformance continuation if chip names hold gains); sector return +6.30% this week. BEARISH: Energy and Utilities — watching for further downside and confirmation of rotated flows.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch for follow-through above this week’s highs in AMD/INTC/QCOM to confirm momentum extension; AAPL and NVDA holding weekly gains would confirm tech leadership; failure of JPM to regain short-term support would deepen Financials’ below-trend profile.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
QCOM (+65): Qualcomm (1W: +23.77% | 1M: +71.50%) ABOVE TREND — CEO AI partnerships headline and price action confirming accumulation. UNH (+70): UnitedHealth (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +23.81%) ABOVE TREND — earnings beat/guide lift and price confirming sentiment.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ASML (-50): ASML (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND — bearish headline but price is rising, a divergence that warrants watching for distribution. (No other high-confidence SP100 names with both news flags and provided returns in the data set this cycle.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership as gains are concentrated in Technology amid weak overall breadth. AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +12.60%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +23.81%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is narrow tech leadership and sentiment/price divergence in names like ASML (-50 news vs ASML (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND) — monitor for trend confirmation.
